subject: MAP: POC activation lane — org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@cardioinsight.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC discussion — next steps / MAP request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — CardioInsight is excited to evaluate Redwood for inference at scale. To keep momentum with our internal procurement and infra teams, could you send a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing on the POC environment activation? Specifically we need steps and owners for: org setup (tenant + RBAC), API key provisioning (ephemeral vs long-lived), IP allowlist ranges and recommended CIDR, and VPC peering options (shared VPC vs peering).

Ideal timeline on our side is to complete activation and begin load tests by the week of Mar 22. Can you confirm whether that’s feasible and flag any blockers we should expect? Also if you have a short template or checklist we can drop into our JIRA, that would be super helpful.

Best,
Claire
VP Product, CardioInsight
--
Claire Wong
claire@cardioinsight.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Wong <claire@cardioinsight.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-26T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC activation lane — org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Claire —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is an initial MAP workbook (Cardio_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that lays out a 4-week activation lane. High level summary below — happy to iterate during a short alignment call.

Quick MAP summary (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): Agreement + DocuSign, HubSpot deal enrichment, and kickoff.
- Week 1: Org and tenant provisioning — we create a customer-scoped org in Redwood Private (or Dedicated) depending on selection; assign admin & audit roles; provide onboarding playbook. Owner: Redwood (Rachel) / Customer (Claire).
- Week 2: API keys & ephemeral key guidance — default to short-lived keys for tests; we provide a test token and instructions for rotating, plus one long-lived service account token if needed for CI. Owner: Redwood (Ben).
- Week 2: IP allowlist — customer to provide egress CIDRs and any gateway IPs; recommended /27 for control plane endpoints; we document which endpoints to allow. Owner: CardioInsight infra (Sandeep) + Redwood (Jordan).
- Week 3: VPC peering & network verification — provide peering template and route diagrams; options: VPC peering (recommended for lower blast radius) or PrivateLink/Transit for larger setups. Owner: CardioInsight infra + Redwood NetEng.
- Week 4: Acceptance & load tests — run agreed throughput/latency tests, validate SLOs, sign-off.

Known prerequisites: SOC2 certificate (for some entitlements), IP ranges, cloud account IDs (for peering), and a point of contact for firewall changes.

Action items for you: confirm desired deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), provide egress CIDRs and account IDs for peering, and confirm target Go/No-Go date (you mentioned Mar 22).

I attached the workbook with the MAP lanes, a lightweight VPC peering checklist, and a one-page runbook for API key rotation. If you prefer, I can convert the workbook to a shared Google Sheet.

Available windows this week for a 30-min sync: Thu 11a-12p PT or Fri 2p-4p PT.

Thanks —
Rachel
Customer Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Attachments: Cardio_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (workbook, MAP draft)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: CardioInsight MAP — infra & security checklist (please review)

Neha / Jordan —

Looping you both in to confirm the security/infrastructure items we promised in the MAP. Claire wants a tight activation lane with a target for load tests week of Mar 22. Key asks below; please reply inline with ETA and any blockers so I can update the MAP workbook.

1) Tenant & RBAC: can we provision a customer-scoped org and generate admin & operator roles? Any policy considerations for CardioInsight (HIPAA not indicated)?
2) API keys: propose issuing a short-lived demo key (48h TTL) + a service account key for CI (rotate every 30 days). Need Jordan to add the steps to runbook and sample curl commands.
3) IP allowlist: ask for recommended control-plane IP range (/27) and guidance for inbound vs outbound rules. If we expose internal metrics endpoints, we should call those out.
4) VPC peering: Neha — what templates do we provide (Terraform snippets or CloudFormation)? Clarify which regions we support for peering and estimated lead time for route propagation.

Attachments: VPC_peering_template_snippet.txt (stub), MAP_internal_notes.md (private).

Rachel

Subject: Re: MAP: POC activation lane — org setup, API keys, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Rachel — thanks for the draft MAP. A few clarifications from infra/security: 

- We can provide egress CIDRs by EOD Monday (we'll give you staging & prod ranges).
- For API keys: we prefer ephemeral tokens for interactive testing. For CI, we need a scoped service account with minimal permissions; can Redwood provide a token exchange flow (short-lived token issued via our service account)? If so, please point to docs.
- VPC peering: CardioInsight uses AWS us-west-2; we'd like a Terraform snippet for the peering attachment and a sample route table change. Are there any cross-account IAM prerequisites on your side?

Also, security asked for SOC2 evidence and an uptime SLA doc to attach to our procurement packet. Can you deliver a redacted SOC2 summary and the SLA excerpt? If you can't share SOC2 in full, the compliance portal link will do.

We're aligned on Mar 22 target but would like activation earlier if possible (Mar 18 would be ideal). Please send the final MAP and peering docs so we can open tickets on our side.

Subject: Re: MAP: POC activation lane — final MAP and activation dates

Claire / Sandeep —

Thanks for the confirmations and the target shift to Mar 18 — good call on accelerating. We've updated the MAP and attached the formal MAP_v1.xlsx and the peering runbook (VPC_peering_instructions.pdf). Summary of commitments below (finalized):

- Activation date (org + test keys + allowlist applied): 2026-03-18 09:00 PT
- Owner: Redwood (Rachel & Jordan) for provisioning; CardioInsight (Sandeep) for CIDR and peering configuration.
- API keys: Redwood will issue a 48h demo token for validation and publish a token-exchange flow for CI (service account + short-lived exchange). Ben will provide sample code snippets and terraform examples in the repo we shared.
- IP allowlist: We recommend opening these outbound control-plane IPs: 34.210.128.32/27 and 52.23.64.0/27 (these are our control endpoints). Please confirm your staging CIDR by EOD tomorrow.
- VPC peering: Terraform snippet included in VPC_peering_instructions.pdf; no cross-account IAM role required on Redwood side for peering attachments — CardioInsight must accept the peering and apply route table change. Estimated propagation 1-2 minutes after acceptance, but allow 30 mins for testing and monitoring.
- Compliance: SOC2 redacted summary and SLA excerpt provided via the compliance portal link in the MAP workbook (see tab: Compliance).

Next steps / links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/2381
- DocuSign for the MAP & EULA: https://www.docusign.com/overview/packet/abc123def (please sign ASAP to keep Mar 18)

Attachments included: MAP_v1.xlsx, VPC_peering_instructions.pdf

If all looks good I'll kick off the provisioning run on Wed morning to hit the Mar 18 activation window.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
